g.text: py-app-letterhead-briefpapier | type letterhead | trim 210 x 297 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: tien printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: Briefpapier_nieuw.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 210 x 297 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 216 x 303 mm.
Variabelen: company = ParkingYou BV; street = Victoriapark 4; postcode-city = 5611 BM Eindhoven; email = info@parkingyou.nl; website = www.parkingyou.nl
Tekstcorrectie in template: "5611BM Eindhoven" wordt "5611 BM Eindhoven (space in the postcode, as on the envelope)" (referentie houdt het origineel).

A4 portrait, no bleed and no BleedBox in the source (page = trim, everything else is white paper); the template adds 3 mm bleed (white). Blank page below the header block. Lockup: py-comp-lockup-logo-tagline-color at scale 0.515 (beeldmerk 12.4 x 14.9 mm at x 20.2, y 12.2; the tagline is live text inside the comp, aqua), the registered mark

py-atom-mark-registered 0.75 mm right of the wordmark, level with its top. Address block: recomposed from py-comp-address-block-brief (right edge 187.26 mm, 3.17 mm Ubuntu, Bold company line) as five live text lines with data-variable (company, street, postcode-city, email, website). The source address text is CMYK 100/85.5/22.3/4 (viewer

#1E4382, a drifted blue, listed in observed); the logo is CMYK 100/83/0/17 (viewer #0B3D8A, equal to the token); the template uses #1A3580 for both. Open point: the source has no fold marks, hole punch mark or address window position; the owner may want to add them if the letterhead goes into window envelopes.
